scope: VRChat SDK components from the pinned official Allowed Avatar Components list, with VRCConstraint expanded into its six concrete types. Avatar usage only; Unity components, FinalIK, Dynamic Bone and world/Udon systems are outside this inventory. Deprecated IK Follower is separate. Statuses are based on the documented release source, not a new live import test.

entries.name: Avatar Descriptor
entries.summary: Avatar root and viewpoint only. Not full avatar behavior.
entries.outcome: The importer identifies avatar roots and reads the authored viewpoint for native avatar creation.
entries.reason: This is not a complete descriptor translation. SDK lip-sync configuration, eye-look settings, playable layers, expression menus and network parameters are not reproduced as a VRChat runtime.

entries.name: PhysBone
entries.outcome: PhysBone simulation and interaction are not translated.
entries.reason: A visible bone chain or retained resting transform is not a physics setup. The importer has no VRCPhysBone-to-native simulation translator.

entries.name: PhysBone Collider
entries.summary: PhysBone collision shapes are not recreated.
entries.outcome: PhysBone collider settings and their simulation links are not translated.
entries.reason: A retained object transform is not a working collider for secondary motion. Native collision setup would need its own translation.

entries.name: Contact Sender
entries.summary: Contact shapes and tags do not transfer.
entries.outcome: The sender shape, contact tags and interaction behavior are not recreated.
entries.reason: Source objects may remain as ordinary transforms. That does not create native contact detection or matching tags.

entries.name: Contact Receiver
entries.summary: No contact detection or parameter output.
entries.outcome: The receiver volume, detection rules and parameter response are not translated.
entries.reason: There is no native conversion of the VRChat contact-to-parameter behavior. Static appearance is not an interactive contact system.

entries.name: Aim Constraint
entries.outcome: Source-driven aim rotation is not translated.
entries.reason: Keeping an authored transform is not a live constraint. VRChat-specific constraint settings and runtime evaluation need a dedicated translator; Unity component handling is not evidence of support for this SDK component.

entries.name: Look At Constraint
entries.outcome: Source-driven look-at tracking is not translated.
entries.reason: Keeping an authored transform is not a live constraint. VRChat-specific constraint settings and runtime evaluation need a dedicated translator; Unity component handling is not evidence of support for this SDK component.

entries.name: Parent Constraint
entries.summary: Source-following and world locking do not transfer.
entries.outcome: The VRChat parent constraint, source weights and freeze-to-world behavior are not translated.
entries.reason: Keeping an authored transform is not a live constraint. VRChat-specific constraint settings and runtime evaluation need a dedicated translator; Unity component handling is not evidence of support for this SDK component.

entries.name: Position Constraint
entries.outcome: Source-weighted position following is not translated.
entries.reason: Keeping an authored transform is not a live constraint. VRChat-specific constraint settings and runtime evaluation need a dedicated translator; Unity component handling is not evidence of support for this SDK component.

entries.name: Rotation Constraint
entries.summary: VRChat rotation constraints are not translated.
entries.outcome: Source-weighted VRChat rotation following is not translated.
entries.reason: Keeping an authored transform is not a live constraint. VRChat-specific constraint settings and runtime evaluation need a dedicated translator; Unity component handling is not evidence of support for this SDK component.

entries.name: Scale Constraint
entries.outcome: Source-weighted scale following is not translated.
entries.reason: Keeping an authored transform is not a live constraint. VRChat-specific constraint settings and runtime evaluation need a dedicated translator; Unity component handling is not evidence of support for this SDK component.

entries.name: Head Chop
entries.summary: Authored first-person hiding rules do not transfer.
entries.outcome: VRChat Head Chop targets and first-person visibility settings are not translated.
entries.reason: Native avatar creation does not imply that authored SDK head-hiding rules were converted.

entries.name: Raycast
entries.outcome: The SDK raycast component is not translated into native raycast behavior.
entries.reason: A retained object or bone is not a functioning raycast system.

entries.name: Spatial Audio Source
entries.summary: SDK audio spatialization settings do not transfer.
entries.outcome: VRChat-specific spatial audio behavior is not translated.
entries.reason: Importing package assets is separate from recreating this SDK component and its playback or spatialization settings.

entries.name: Station
entries.summary: No automatic native seat or station setup.
entries.outcome: SDK station entry, exit and seating behavior are not recreated.
entries.reason: The station component needs a dedicated native translation; a preserved transform is not an interactive seat.

entries.name: Pipeline Manager
entries.summary: VRChat upload identity. Not a Resonite feature.
entries.outcome: VRChat blueprint and publishing identity are not carried into Resonite.
entries.reason: These identifiers belong to VRChat publishing. They do not establish a native runtime capability and are excluded from the progress total.

entries.name: IK Follower
entries.outcome: The deprecated IK Follower component is not translated.
entries.reason: The upstream avatar component list marks this component deprecated in favor of VRChat constraints. It is separate from the current collection.
